title: Config module, schema validator and two demo tenants
story: As a carrier admin I can read, validate and update tenant configuration, and two materially different demo tenants ship ready to load.
acceptance: src/modules/config/validator.js exports a zero-dependency JSON Schema subset validator (type, required, properties, items, enum, const, pattern, min/max, additionalProperties, $ref to local and sibling schema files, oneOf/anyOf) and tests/unit/config/validator.test.js passes

src/modules/config/service.js exports validateTenantConfig(cfg) returning {valid,errors[]} with schema errors plus semantic errors: invalid rule conditions (via rules.validateRules, tolerated absent with a local fake in tests), duplicate question ids, timers referencing unknown states; each covered by a named test

Module exports service(ctx) and registers validateTenantConfig through ctx.tenants.addValidator; routes match openapi /config paths with x-roles enforced; updates publish tenant.config.updated and write audit

tenants/aurelia-mutual.json and tenants/kestrel-point.json both pass validateTenantConfig (tests/unit/config/tenants.test.js) and differ in branding, LOBs, states, locales, STP thresholds, SIU threshold, queues, timers

Aurelia: personal_auto + homeowners, WI+IL, en+es, aggressive STP (glass and home under 2500); Kestrel: personal_auto + commercial_auto, MI, en only, STP glass only, stricter SIU threshold; question sets with showIf per LOB/loss type; synthetic adjusters; timers labelled illustrative, not legal advice; webhooks; ai provider cascade with local first
Only synthetic data; no real carrier or person names; no secrets in files
brief: Read product/requirements.md lines ~120-135 first and follow them exactly. Build in src/modules/config/: validator.js (small recursive JSON Schema subset; resolve $ref relative to architecture/contracts/domain/ by loading files at runtime via fs; make it reusable, export validate(schema,data,{resolve})), service.js (validateTenantConfig, getConfig, putConfig, publishing flow per modules.md#config using ctx.tenants, ctx.audit, ctx.events), routes.js (per openapi /config), index.js exporting service(ctx) and registering the validator with ctx.tenants.addValidator. Use architecture/core-runtime-api.md for exact ctx shapes and the tenant-bound ctx addendum; do not guess method names. rules.validateRules lives in another team's parallel ticket (S1-WFL-02): call ctx.modules.rules?.validateRules if present, otherwise skip, and use a local fake in tests. Semantic checks: question ids unique per tenant, every timer's state references a lifecycle state from architecture/overview.md section 7, rule conditions valid. Demo tenants: write JSON against the schema, check required fields carefully; use the condition language in architecture/domain-model.md for showIf and STP/routing rules. Timer deadlines for WI/IL/MI should be plausible day counts with description text 'Illustrative, not legal advice'. Provide at least 4 queues per tenant with 2-3 fake adjusters each (needed by round-robin routing). Pitfall: do not edit package.json; run only node --test --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning tests/unit/config/. Post any contract gap to the architecture hub.

verdicts.reason: All criteria met; 53/53 config tests pass; routes, event/audit, tenant differentiation, synthetic data verified. Nit: validator test file is .mjs not .js.
